FILLING OF A VACANCY UNDER PARAGRAPH 13(B) OF ARTICLE 99 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA

WHEREAS, the Secretary General of Parliament has informed the Election Commission, under Section 64(1) of the Parliamentary Elections Act, No. 1 of 1981, that a vacancy has occurred in the membership of the Ninth Parliament by reason of the dismissal by the Supreme Court of the petition No. SC/(EXPULSION) No. 02/2023 ﬁ led in the Supreme Court against the expulsion of Mr. Maligaspe Koralege Nalin Manusha Nanayakkara from the Samagi Jana Balawegaya party, who was declared elected as a Member of Parliament for the Electoral District No. 07 – Galle under Section 62 of the aforesaid Act;

WHEREAS, the Returning Ofﬁ cer for the electoral district which returned the said member was directed by the Election Commission under Section 64(1) of the Parliamentary Elections Act, No. 1 of 1981, to ﬁ ll this vacancy as provided for under Sub Article 99(13)(B) of the Constitution;

AND WHEREAS, the said Returning Ofﬁ cer acting under Section 64(2) of the Parliamentary Elections Act, No. 1 of 1981, and in terms of Sub Article 99(13)(B) of the Constitution has made a return in Form “M” set out in the First Schedule to the aforesaid Act, to the effect that Mr. Bandula Lal Bandarigoda was declared elected as a Member of Parliament for the said electoral district;

NOW THEREFORE, the Election Commission, in the exercise of the powers vested in the Election Commission by Section 64 (2) of the Parliamentary Elections Act, No. 1 of 1981, does hereby notify that Mr. Bandula Lal Bandarigoda has been declared elected as a Member of the Ninth Parliament for the Electoral District No. 07 – Galle to ﬁ ll the vacancy caused by reason of the dismissal by the Supreme Court of the petition No. SC/(EXPULSION) No. 02/2023 ﬁ led in the Supreme Court against the expulsion of Mr. Maligaspe Koralege Nalin Manusha Nanayakkara from the Samagi Jana Balawegaya party.
